title: Implement Frontend Dashboard
result_summary: Frontend Dashboard implemented with Vite+React. API Client connected to Backend (Port 3002).
goal: Create a web-based dashboard for the Master Inspector (Admin) to view and manage leads.

context.user_story: As the Master Inspector, I want to see a list of contacts and their interaction history so that I can intervene if the AI fails.
context.requirements: React-based SPA, connect to Backend API, display Contacts list, display Chat history.

sub_tasks.output: Implement API Client (Axios) to fetch /contacts and /interactions.
Build Dashboard UI (Sidebar, Contact List, Chat View).

decisions: Use Vanilla CSS as per design guidelines.
Keep state management simple (React Context or local state) for V1.
acceptance_criteria: Can view list of contacts from DB.
Can click a contact to view message history.
